title: openai /v1/chat.completions parity: streaming stability, tool/function calling, roles/stop/logprobs, response formatting
author: Priya Patel
release_notes: Implements OpenAI /v1/chat.completions parity improvements: streaming stability, function/tool calling semantics, roles handling, stop/logprobs support, and structured response formatting. Backward compatible by default; opt-in flags available for stricter parity.
description: Context and motivation: Customers relying on the OpenAI /v1/chat.completions semantics expect specific behaviors around streaming deltas, role emission, function/tool calling payloads, stop sequence handling, and conditional inclusion of token logprobs. Several customers reported subtle compatibility regressions when switching to Redwood's OpenAI compatibility layer (linear ENG-2451, support ticket SUP-1120). This PR consolidates parity work across the API surface to reduce application-level differences and hard-to-debug integration issues. Changes: - Streaming stability: ensure deterministic chunk ordering, emit 'role' only on first message per choice, include final 'finish_reason' consistently, and attach partial text deltas in the same sequence OpenAI clients expect. - Tool/function calling: match OpenAI semantics for function call hints (name/content fields), structured function call events in streaming mode, and the non-blocking choice of tool invocation vs. text continuation. - Roles and stop handling: support role propagation from system/user/assistant in both batched and streaming paths, accept multiple stop sequences, and respect stop heuristics when mixing function calls and stop tokens. - Logprobs: add optional per-token logprobs when logprobs parameter is provided; ensure stability across streaming (partial logprobs) and final responses. - Response formatting: structured output (JSON schema/format hints) preserved between streaming and non-streaming modes; update Content-Type and response envelope to avoid double-encoding by downstream clients. Implementation notes: - Runtime: extended the OpenAI compatibility shim in crates/runtime to interpret incoming OpenAI-style params and translate them to the internal serving config. New translation path preserves fields not yet supported and passes them downstream when possible. - Streaming: introduced an ordered chunk queue + sequence checks in server/src/handlers/chat_completions.rs to ensure stable ordering under concurrent batching. Added a small backpressure heuristic to avoid out-of-order delivery on high-concurrency hosts. - Function calls: unified the function-call event model between the internal evaluator and the OpenAI shim; streaming emits a 'function_call' delta event followed by the function content in subsequent deltas, matching OpenAI reference. - Tests: added e2e tests in tests/openai_compat/e2e_chat_parity.rs and multiple Python SDK integration tests in sdk/python/tests/test_chat_parity.py to validate behaviors across streaming and non-streaming flows. - Docs: updated docs/openai-compat.md with migration guidance and examples showing the new streaming delta format and function call examples. Backward compatibility and opt-ins: - Default behavior remains backwards-compatible for existing Redwood customers; strict OpenAI parity is enabled when requests include compat_mode=openai_parity or when using the dedicated openai_compat shim in SDKs. Checklist: - [x] Implement translation layer for OpenAI params - [x] Stabilize streaming chunk ordering - [x] Add function/tool calling streaming events - [x] Support roles and multiple stop tokens - [x] Add optional logprobs streaming/final support - [x] Add e2e and SDK tests - [x] Update docs and migration notes Known limitations / follow-ups: - Very large function outputs still show increased latency when streaming; follow-up optimization scheduled ENG-2603. - Some rare race in batching + kv-cache invalidation observed at >2000 RPS; mitigations are in place and additional fixes will land in a separate PR. Related work: pr-56123 (previous parity pass), ENG-2451, SUP-1120.
commits: feat(openai-compat): add param translation for temperature/top_p/stop/logprobs/streaming
fix(stream): deterministic chunk ordering and role-first-emission
feat(functions): emit function_call delta and function content deltas in streaming mode
perf(runtime): small backpressure heuristic for high concurrency streaming
test(e2e): add chat parity e2e tests (streaming and non-streaming)
docs: update openai-compat.md with migration examples
review_comments: Alex Chen: Left a few nits in openai.rs around param validation. Can we add a sanitize step for unknown fields to avoid silently dropping them?
Priya Patel: Reply: added sanitize step and unit tests for unknown fields mapping (see commit).
Diego Martinez: Streaming queue looks good, but I'm concerned about memory growth. Can we add a size limit and eviction?
Priya Patel: Reply: added size limit with a soft eviction policy and metrics; documented the policy in chunk_queue.rs
Katherine Liu: Tests failing intermittently in CI for the python e2e test (serialization of function args). I think it's a flake in the test harness.
Priya Patel: Reply: tightened the test harness timing and fixed a race in the SDK test. Re-ran CI and the flake did not reproduce.
